title: CR-PAY-015 — Reverse-invoice operator
preconds: Permissions (counted): Work Orders V+E+D. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: See WOs; create/edit WOs; delete WOs.

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks. See Flag / Note.
Spec Ref: §1a
Flag / Note: \u26a0 reverse = WO Delete (6/28); not enough to delete payments
